headline: Sabres place Konsta Helenius on injured reserve, activate Alex Lyon
take:
Daily Faceoff reports the Sabres have placed forward Konsta Helenius on injured reserve and activated goalie Alex Lyon, who had been out since a shoulder injury in a September preseason game. The Athletic's Matthew Fairburn posted the same move, with Helenius going on IR to make room.

Helenius has been a quiet, steady third-liner so far this season: 3 points in 11 games at 12.99 minutes a night, with the Sabres holding 51.38% of the 5-on-5 expected goals (the quality of chances) when he plays. He sits about 0.15 goals below what his chances predict, so his results aren't hiding anything big. With him out for 5 games already, we can go by what BUF has actually done: Jason Zucker has taken his spot beside Norris and Kulich, Peyton Krebs is up to 15:50 a night from 11:59, and Sam Carrick is up to 8:46 from 5:46. That matters for a 8-7-3 team that has been 6.4 goals worse than its chances suggest, since depth minutes are going to Krebs and Carrick instead.
